purpose: Audit city-scoped land/cadastre evidence separately from accessible public parcel geometry; record only executed searches and actual page/request outcomes.
name: Tripoli
pointBasis: Chosen approximate central-city query point; not a WUP centroid or official boundary.
jurisdiction: Tripoli municipality and wider Tripoli region; Real Estate Registration Authority and Survey Department hold cadastral functions. The Libyan Spatial Data Infrastructure portal lists property-boundary mapping products.
registryBasis: A Tripoli-based electronic center archives national real-estate files, and the Libyan SDI catalogue describes national property-boundary raster sheets. The inspected primary sources do not identify a Tripoli parcel-record subset; office location alone is not treated as city coverage. Public city geometry remains unverified.
findings: A fresh open of the official Libyan SDI portal returned an empty search view with an Arabic error message; HTTP status was not exposed and no current catalogue results appeared. The indexed search snippet had listed property-boundary basemap images (not vector polygons), so that remains discovery-only. A directly opened 2020 LANA report documents the Real Estate Registration Authority’s central electronic archive in Tripoli for nationwide files, but does not expose parcels. No public parcel-vector service or point query was verified.
